newsitem.title: FRANCE: Arafat attends World Bank Palestine donor meeting.
newsitem.headline: Arafat attends World Bank Palestine donor meeting.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat on Wednesday attended a donors' meeting of the World Bank's Consultative Group on the West Bank and Gaza.

Arafat made no comment to reporters as he arrived at the Paris meeting, intended to solicit pledges from some 40 countries and international organisations for aid for World Bank programmes in the autonomous Palestinian areas for 1997.
Arafat was to hold a news conference at 1630 GMT following the donors' meeting.

The meeting opened during a time of severe economic strain in the West Bank and Gaza following Israel's decision to close off those areas in February after a wave of bomb attacks by Moslem fundamentalists killed dozens of people in Israel.
The World Bank said the political situation had resulted in projections of a five percent decline of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) for 1996 in the autonomous Palestinian areas.

A main hope for improvement is the expected opening in about two months of the al-Muntar industrial park on the Palestinian side of the Israel-Gaza Strip border, World Bank officials said ahead of the meeting. Under optimal conditions, the project will employ 17,000 people directly, mostly in textiles, and 35,000 indirectly by early 1998.
